kind: borrowed durable checksum; no persisted product record

owners.byte_traversal: metadata-bound closed IC tree verification; private manifest publication also hashes the original tree

admission.intent: journal intent equals the full canonical original plan digest
admission.coverage: exactly one original stage target and one artifact; missing, extra or substituted targets reject
admission.state: sole artifact Durable with its required retained checksum
admission.snapshot: identity and metadata stay exactly journal-owned; original pre-capture plan cannot establish later captured ID

fresh_checks: admit retained original plan by exact digest and require held journal equality before byte IO
require original metadata timestamp, exact raw metadata/request hashes and independently qualified token/raw-ID association
verify bounded region/chunk identities and the fixed closed tree with no-follow descriptors
recheck file/directory custody and retained original plan/journal after traversal

errors.ops: IcSnapshotArtifactError retains original/shape/custody/coverage/checksum and original-record failures; private manifest hashing retains DownloadIntegrityError

custody.cooperating_layout_and_journal_exclusion: existing guards; checksum borrows the admitted journal, but does not carry byte custody
custody.verification: sequential observations, not an atomic filesystem snapshot
custody.integration: maintain stable byte custody and authenticate retained capture/receipt and backend transfer evidence

retention: no record rewrite or journal transition on success or failure
ordinary reopen/resume reads retained progress without fresh byte verification
no refund or replenishment of original attempts
no reference release, prune or artifact deletion
non_authority: no current IC permission or authenticated transport
no captured snapshot identity or complete metadata/extent transfer proof
no application consistency or distributed checkpoint
no effect settlement, terminal proof, restart or dispatch permit
qualification: native policy, private manifest/publication and public metadata-bound source recovery checks; IC effects require separate authenticated qualification
